name: sparsew2t env build (micromamba, CPU, needs internet)
command: set -eo pipefail; L=$CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/build.log; mkdir -p /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache; cd /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache; echo "[1/4] host $(hostname) python3 $(python3 --version 2>&1)" | tee -a $L; if [ ! -x bin/micromamba ]; then curl -fLs https://micro.mamba.pm/api/micromamba/linux-64/latest -o mm.tar.bz2; python3 -c "import tarfile; tarfile.open('mm.tar.bz2').extract('bin/micromamba', '.')"; fi; echo "[2/4] micromamba $(./bin/micromamba --version)" | tee -a $L; export MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX=/home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache/mamba PIP_CACHE_DIR=/home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/cache/pip; rm -rf /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env; ./bin/micromamba create -y -p /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env -f /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/repo/environment.yml 2>&1 | tail -n 60 | tee -a $L; echo '[3/4] env created' | tee -a $L; /home/sudingli/cq-home/sparsew2t/env/bin/python -c 'import torch, numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn, yaml, tabulate, baostock; print("imports ok", torch.__version__, numpy.__version__, pandas.__version__)' 2>&1 | tee -a $L; echo '[4/4] done' | tee -a $L; touch $CQ_OUTPUT_DIR/env.ok
